title: The Picture of Dorian Gray

vibeProfile.oneLine: A man stays young while his hidden portrait rots with every sin.

summary: A beautiful young man wishes that his portrait would age in his place, and gets his wish: as Dorian Gray plunges into a life of pleasure and cruelty, his face stays flawless while the hidden picture rots with every sin. Wilde's only novel is a glittering Gothic fable about beauty, corruption and the price of a life without conscience, studded with his famous epigrams. Scandalous in its day, it remains a deliciously wicked meditation on vanity and the soul.
whyReadIt: Wilde's glittering, wicked Gothic fable about beauty and corruption. Full of epigrams and quietly terrifying.

funFacts.text: The novel's frankness was used against Wilde at his later trials.
